name: z-ai/glm-5.3
description: GLM-5.3 is Z.ai's flagship text model for complex software engineering and long-horizon agent work, built on the same base model as GLM-5.2 with all gains coming from expanded post-training. Z.ai highlights stronger agentic coding, terminal operation, and vulnerability discovery and exploitation analysis for security work. It always runs with reasoning enabled at selectable effort levels and accepts text only; choose GLM-5.3-Flash for image input or lighter, faster serving.
